subject: Discovery recap + model readiness checklist for FinX pilot
messages:
From: Tom Keller <tkeller@finx.io>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@finx.io>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap from today

Camila — thanks for the demo and the clear walk-through. A few things we wanted to lock down from our side so we can scope the pilot: 

- Primary POC: customer support triage (short text classification + suggested replies).
- Target latency: sub-250ms p95 for single-turn prompt (90% of flows are short).
- Quality bar: >= 92% accuracy on our judgment set for intent classification; reply suggestions should be helpful in >= 85% of sampled tickets.
- Data constraints: no customer PII should leave our VPC during evaluation; we need an NDA addendum for data handling.

We'll attach a sanitized sample of 200 tickets and an initial prompt set. Expect those by COB today.

Thanks — Tom

[Attachment: finx_sample_sanitized_200.csv (CSV)]

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: Tom Keller <tkeller@finx.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-18T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap from today

Tom — great to connect. Appreciate the clear success criteria. Next steps from Redwood: 

1) We will run a small fit evaluation on your 200-ticket sample using two candidate variants: a higher-capacity open model (gptx-13b-redwood-v1) and a smaller quantized variant (gptx-13b-redwood-q8-lite). Estimated runtime: 18-24 hours to produce per-prompt metrics.
2) Rishi will share benchmark links and the baseline prompt set we'll use for the eval.
3) We'll propose an initial mutual action plan (attached) with a pilot timeline and success gates.

A couple of operational notes upfront: 
- For the VPC/private handling you mentioned, we can run the eval in your VPC or a dedicated Redwood Private deployment; we'll list both options in the MAP and surface any trade-offs (latency and cost).
- If the eval shows a regression vs your current system on reply-quality, we propose a safety ladder: immediate pin to the validated model version used in the eval + temporary canary routing to the heavier variant until we triage diffs.

I'll loop Rishi now for the technical specifics. 

Best,
Camila Reyes

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Tom Keller <tkeller@finx.io>, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-18T19:28:00-07:00
Subject: Eval plan, model choices, and regression guardrails

Tom / Priya — thanks for the sample and the criteria. Quick technical plan and what we'll report back: 

Eval plan (what we'll run):
- Candidate models: gptx-13b-redwood-v1 (float16, production kernel), gptx-13b-redwood-q8-lite (8-bit quant, lower mem).
- Metrics: intent accuracy, reply helpfulness (human-rated 1-5), hallucination rate (false factual assertions), avg latency p50/p95, and per-token cost estimate.
- Prompt sets: we'll evaluate the prompt family you sent plus two controlled prompt variants we generate (short-context and context-rich).

Benchmark artifacts we'll provide:
- A CSV of per-ticket predictions (with anonymized IDs) and metric columns.
- A side-by-side diff report (per-example) highlighting where the two variants disagree and where either drops below your thresholds.
- A lightweight eval dashboard link (read-only).

Regression controls / rollback logic: 
- Pinning rule: if the deployed variant has a >4% drop in intent accuracy or >7-point drop in reply helpfulness vs the eval baseline, we will recommend immediate pin to the last-green model version and initiate a rollback window (configurable, default 24 hours).
- Canary traffic: for early rollouts we recommend 10% canary for 48 hours with automated rollback on metric breach.
- Root-cause artifacts: we'll include prompt-level diffs and candidate example traces (KV cache traces where relevant) to speed triage.

Operational constraints to note: the quantized variant may hit your sub-250ms p95 only under workload-aware batching; if strict single-request latency is required we may need the float16 variant. We'll surface precise numbers in the benchmark PDF.

Links and artifacts (will be uploaded):
- Benchmark summary PDF (finx_benchmark_summary_20270418.pdf)
- Per-example CSV and prompt-set (finx_prompt_set_v1.csv)
- Eval dashboard: https://redwood.app/evals/DEAL-7834/summary

I'll kick off the eval run tonight and ping once the first pass is done.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: Tom Keller <tkeller@finx.io>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@finx.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-19T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + model readiness checklist for FinX pilot

Tom / Priya — thanks for the quick turnaround on the sample. Two quick asks and a proposed acceptance checklist so we can move to pilot: 

Acceptance checklist (must-haves to sign pilot):
- NDA addendum signed for VPC handling (legal sent an addendum if you need it).
- Eval baseline metrics: intent accuracy >= 92% on your judgment set AND reply helpfulness >= 85% (human sample).
- Operational: confirmation on VPC vs Redwood Private; if VPC, provide the network handoff window next week.
- Rollout policy: agree to canary percent (default 10%) and rollback triggers above; acknowledge pinning behavior if regression is detected.

Contingency triggers (what we will do if quality regressions are observed during pilot rollout):
- Minor diffs (<=3% intent delta, <=4 points helpfulness): escalate to engineering for prompt tuning and re-run of targeted eval on flagged prompt families.
- Significant regressions (metrics exceed pin thresholds): automatic pin to last-green model version, temporary rollback of canary, and 24h triage SLA.
- Persistent discrepancies linked to quantization/latency trade-offs: recommend option to run critical flows on float16 variant and bulk/batched flows on q8 variant.

Proposed next steps:
1) Sign NDA addendum (we can send via DocuSign).
2) Redwood to complete first-pass eval and upload artifacts by EOD tomorrow.
3) Joint review call: Thu 04/22 10:00am PT — confirm if that works.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
